lines.en: You can use less salt and sauce, and flavour food with herbs, spices or lemon juice instead.
lines.zh: 可以少用盐和酱料，改用香草、香料或柠檬汁调味。

lines.en: You can cut back on salty preserved foods such as salted fish, salted egg, ikan bilis and luncheon meat.
lines.zh: 咸鱼、咸蛋、江鱼仔、午餐肉等高盐腌制食物，可以少吃。

lines.en: When eating out, you can ask for sauce on the side, and taste first before adding salt or sauce.
lines.zh: 外出用餐时，可以要求酱料分开放，先尝味道再考虑加盐或酱料。

lines.en: You can leave some of the soup and gravy instead of finishing all of it.
lines.zh: 汤和汁可以留下一些，不必全部喝完。

lines.en: When buying food, you can choose fresh over processed food, and products with the Healthier Choice Symbol.
lines.zh: 购物时可选新鲜而非加工的食物，及有“较健康选择”标志的产品。

lines.en: Following My Healthy Plate, your meals can include wholegrains, lean meat or other protein, and vegetables and fruit.
lines.zh: 可参照“我的健康餐盘”，饮食包括全谷类、瘦肉等蛋白质和蔬果。

lines.en: On My Healthy Plate, fruit and vegetables fill the biggest part; wholegrains and protein share the rest equally.
lines.zh: “我的健康餐盘”：蔬果占最大部分，全谷类和蛋白质平分其余。

lines.en: You can pick wholegrain foods, such as brown rice, rather than refined ones like white rice.
lines.zh: 可以用全谷类代替精制谷类，例如用糙米代替白米。

lines.en: You can make plain water your usual drink, in place of sugary drinks.
lines.zh: 平时可以选白开水，代替含糖饮料。

lines.en: You can have fruit whole, rather than as fruit juice.
lines.zh: 可以吃整个水果，代替喝果汁。

lines.en: You can keep to regular mealtimes each day.
lines.zh: 可以每天定时吃饭。

lines.en: For economy rice, you can choose brown rice, more vegetables, and steamed, braised or stir-fried dishes over deep-fried ones.
lines.zh: 吃经济饭可选糙米、多点蔬菜，以蒸焖炒的菜代替油炸菜。

lines.en: You can cut down on fatty meat, poultry skin, full-cream milk, butter, ghee, coconut milk and palm oil.
lines.zh: 可以减少肥肉、鸡鸭皮、全脂奶、牛油、酥油、椰浆和棕榈油。

lines.en: You can choose fish, lean meat, low-fat dairy, and poultry with the skin removed.
lines.zh: 可以选择鱼、瘦肉、低脂奶制品和去皮的鸡鸭。

lines.en: For cooking, you can use oils such as olive, canola, peanut, corn, sunflower or soybean oil.
lines.zh: 煮食可选橄榄油、芥花籽油、花生油、玉米油、葵花籽油等。

lines.en: At home, you can use less oil and steam or bake food more often.
lines.zh: 在家可以少用油，多用蒸或烤的方式煮食。

lines.en: You can limit how often you eat deep-fried food.
lines.zh: 可以减少吃油炸食物的次数。

lines.en: Fruit, vegetables, grains like oats and barley, and beans and peas can feature more in your meals.
lines.zh: 可以多吃蔬果、燕麦和大麦等谷类，以及豆类。

lines.en: You can ask for less sauce and gravy, and leave some of the soup in soup dishes.
lines.zh: 可以要求少酱少汁；吃带汤的食物时，汤可以不喝完。

lines.en: When having noodles, you can pick soup versions more often than fried ones or those in thick gravy.
lines.zh: 吃面时，可以多选汤面，少选炒面或浓汁面。

lines.en: For chicken rice, you can ask for plain white rice in place of the flavoured rice.
lines.zh: 吃鸡饭时，可以要白饭，代替油饭。

lines.en: For nasi lemak, you can take less gravy and less coconut rice, and pick vegetables over deep-fried items.
lines.zh: 吃椰浆饭时，可以少汁、少饭，以蔬菜代替油炸配菜。

lines.en: At the economy rice stall, you can go for meat dishes cooked together with vegetables.
lines.zh: 吃经济饭时，可以选和蔬菜一起煮的肉类菜。

lines.en: With chicken or fish porridge, you can skip the fried dough fritters (you tiao).
lines.zh: 吃鸡肉粥或鱼片粥时，可以不加油条。

lines.en: In place of roti prata, you can choose chapati or thosai.
lines.zh: 可以选印度麦饼或thosai，代替印度煎饼。

lines.en: For wanton noodles, you can skip the deep-fried wontons and look for stalls using leaner meat.
lines.zh: 吃云吞面时，可以不要炸云吞，找用瘦肉的摊位。

lines.en: When ordering kopi or teh, you can say siu dai for less sugar or kosong for none.
lines.zh: 咖啡或茶可点siu dai（少糖）或kosong（无糖）。

lines.en: At hawker centres, you can look for stalls that display the Healthier Choice Symbol.
lines.zh: 在小贩中心，可以留意挂有“较健康选择”标志的摊位。

lines.en: When choosing a stall, you can look for the Healthier Dining identifier shown at the front.
lines.zh: 可以留意摊位前的“Healthier Dining”标识。
